subtopic: 05 · Trigonometric Identities and Compound Angle Formulas
title: Product-to-sum, sum-to-product, amplitude and conditional identities

board_content.text: Amplitude and conditional (A + B + C = π)

board_content.latex: a\cos x+b\sin x=R\cos(x-\alpha),\ R=\sqrt{a^2+b^2};\qquad \tan A+\tan B+\tan C=\tan A\tan B\tan C

segments_english.text: The last formula block: turning products into sums and back, plus two headline results.

Product to sum: twice sine A cosine B is sine of A plus B plus sine of A minus B; twice cosine A cosine B is cosine of A plus B plus cosine of A minus B. The leading two is part of the formula, never drop it.
And twice sine A sine B is cosine of A minus B minus cosine of A plus B.
Now run it backwards, sum to product.
Sine C plus sine D is two sine of the half-sum times cosine of the half-difference; cosine C plus cosine D is two cosine of the half-sum times cosine of the half-difference.
The one to watch: cosine C minus cosine D carries a leading minus, it's minus two sine of the half-sum times sine of the half-difference.

The amplitude form, a cosine x plus b sine x equals R cosine of x minus alpha with R the root of a squared plus b squared, instantly gives max and min; and the conditional identity, true only when A plus B plus C is pi, says the sum of tangents equals their product.

segments_hinglish.text: आख़िरी formula block: products को sums में बदलना और वापस, plus दो headline results.

Product to sum: twice sine A cosine B है sine of A plus B plus sine of A minus B; twice cosine A cosine B है cosine of A plus B plus cosine of A minus B. Leading two formula का हिस्सा है, कभी मत छोड़िए.
और twice sine A sine B है cosine of A minus B minus cosine of A plus B.
अब इसे उल्टा चलाइए, sum to product.
Sine C plus sine D है two sine of half-sum times cosine of half-difference; cosine C plus cosine D है two cosine of half-sum times cosine of half-difference.
जिसका ध्यान रखना है: cosine C minus cosine D leading minus रखता है, ये है minus two sine of half-sum times sine of half-difference.

Amplitude form, a cosine x plus b sine x equals R cosine of x minus alpha, R root of a squared plus b squared के साथ, तुरंत max और min देता है; और conditional identity, सिर्फ़ तभी सच जब A plus B plus C is pi, कहती है sum of tangents बराबर उनका product.
